z-m-35-03.title: Ɗalibai nawa ne suka shiga ƙungiyoyin biyu? Wane ƙarin bayani muke bukata?
z-m-35-03.topic: Yawan abubuwan da ke cikin haɗin ƙungiyoyi, da bayanin da ake buƙata
z-m-35-03.goal: Nemo iyakar ƙimar da dangantakar yawan abubuwa kaɗai ta ƙayyade, ka bambanta bayanin da ake buƙata domin ƙayyade ƙima guda da wanda ba ya taimakawa, sannan ka gina yanayi masu yiwuwa da kanka.
z-m-35-03.material: A cikin ɗalibai 40 na makarantar gaba ɗaya, 30 mambobin ƙungiyar A ne, 25 kuma mambobin ƙungiyar B ne. Akwai yiwuwar ɗaliban da suka shiga ƙungiyoyin biyu da kuma waɗanda ba su shiga ko ɗaya ba. Bari x ya zama yawan ɗaliban da suka shiga ƙungiyoyin biyu, z kuma yawan waɗanda ba su shiga ko ɗaya ba. A ƙasa, za mu bincika abin da za a iya sani game da x.

z-m-35-03.s.s1.hint.1: Canja x da ƙima ɗaya-ɗaya, sannan ka duba ko 'yawan ɗalibai daban-daban da suka shiga' ya wuce 40 da ko x ya wuce 25.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.a: 15 ita ce ƙimar da ake samu idan kowane ɗalibi ya shiga aƙalla ƙungiya ɗaya. Ka duba ko an bayar da wannan gaskiyar a tambayar.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.o.b: Ba a ƙayyade x ba, kuma yana iya zama kowace ƙima daga 0 zuwa 25
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.b: Idan x = 0, nemo jimillar yawan mambobi, sannan ka kwatanta ta da 40.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana amfani tare da sharadin cewa haɗin A∪B ba zai fi yawan ɗaliban makarantar gaba ɗaya ba da kuma sharadin cewa x ba zai fi yawan membobin kulob ɗaya ba.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.o.d: Bayanin bai isa ba, saboda haka ba za a iya cewa komai game da x ba
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.d: Rashin kayyade ƙima guda ɗaya ba yana nufin ba za ka iya sanin zangon ba. Gwada wasu ƙimomi da za su yiwu da kanka.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.explain: Yawan abubuwan da ke cikin A∪B shi ne 30+25−x=55−x, kuma ba zai wuce ɗaliban makarantar gaba ɗaya 40 ba, don haka 55−x≤40, wato x≥15. Haka kuma x ba zai wuce membobin B 25 ba, saboda haka x≤25. 15 da 25 dukansu suna yiwuwa da gaske (15 idan kowa ya shiga, 25 idan duk membobin B sun shiga A ma), don haka za a iya cewa x yana daga 15 zuwa 25.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk ƙarin bayanan da ke ƙasa waɗanda sanin wannan bayani guda ɗaya kaɗai zai kayyade x zuwa ƙima guda. (Ka yi tunanin ƙara kowane bayani dabam-dabam, ɗaya bayan ɗaya.)

z-m-35-03.s.s2.hint.1: Rarraba sakamakon ko yana ba da ƙimar x guda, zangonsa kawai, ko kuma maimaita bayanin da ka riga ka sani.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.a: Akwai ɗalibai 6 da ba su shiga ko wane kulob ba
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.a: Da wannan bayanin, yawan ɗalibai mabambanta da suka shiga ya kayyade. Lissafa ko za ka iya nemo x daga wannan adadin.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.b: Akwai ƙarin ɗalibai 5 da suka shiga A kaɗai fiye da waɗanda suka shiga B kaɗai
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.b: Rubuta adadin biyun ta fuskar x, lissafa bambancin, sannan ka duba ko x ya rage ko ya soke.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.c: Ɗaliban da suka shiga A ko B sun kai aƙalla 80% na makarantar gaba ɗaya
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.c: Sharadin da ke cewa 'aƙalla' yana barin zangon ƙimomi, ba ƙima guda ba. Rubuta wasu ƙimomin x da za su yiwu ƙarƙashin wannan sharadi.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.d: Akwai ɗalibai 10 da suka shiga B kaɗai
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.d: Duba ko za a iya amfani da wannan kai tsaye wajen nemo ɗaliban cikin membobin B 25 waɗanda suka shiga A ma.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.e: Daga cikin ɗaliban makaranta 40, maza 22 ne
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.e: Yi tunanin ko bayanin jinsi yana da alaƙa da shiga kulob; idan yana da ita, ta wace hanya.

z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.prompt: A cikin yanayi ukun da ka ƙirƙira, ta yaya z ke canzawa yayin da x ke ƙaruwa? Bayyana dalili ta haɗa shi da ɗaliban makarantar gaba ɗaya 40.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.hint.0: Canza x zuwa 15, 18, 25, sannan ka yi jadawalin yadda z ke canzawa.

z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.model.0: Yayin da x ke ƙaruwa, z ma yana ƙaruwa. Yawan ɗaliban da suka shiga kulob biyun yana ƙaruwa, saboda haka yawan ɗalibai mabambanta da suka shiga (55−x) yana raguwa; sai yawan waɗanda ba su shiga daga cikin 40 ya ƙaru.

z-m-35-01.title: Maganin da ya ce yawan ɗaliban da ba su yi rajista da ko wanne ba shi ne 20
z-m-35-01.topic: Kammalawar haɗin ƙungiyoyi da kuma haɗuwar ƙungiyoyi, da yawan abubuwa
z-m-35-01.goal: Nemo kuskuren da ya faru a layi ɗaya na maganin lokacin da aka juya 'ba ... ko ... ba' zuwa alamar ƙungiya, ka gyara shi, sannan ka faɗi waɗanda ainihin lissafin ya ƙirga.
z-m-35-01.material: Ɗauki ɗalibai 24 na aji a matsayin cikakkiyar ƙungiya U. A rajistar ayyukan bayan makaranta, A ita ce ƙungiyar ɗaliban da suka shiga ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa (ɗalibai 13), B kuma ita ce ƙungiyar waɗanda suka shiga ƙwallon kwando (ɗalibai 10), kuma ɗalibai 4 sun shiga duka biyun. Ɗalibi na iya shiga duka biyun ko kuma babu ɗaya. Jisu ya yi ƙoƙarin nemo 'yawan ɗaliban da ba su shiga ƙwallon ƙafa ko ƙwallon kwando ba' kuma ya warware kamar haka. (Yadda ake karanta alamomin: Aᶜ ita ce 'kammalawar A', ∪ na nufin 'haɗin ƙungiyoyi', ∩ na nufin 'haɗuwar ƙungiyoyi', n(A) kuma shi ne 'yawan abubuwan da ke cikin ƙungiya'.)

z-m-35-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yanke shawara dabam ko wannan ɗalibin yana cikin 'ɗaliban da ba su shiga ƙwallon ƙafa ko ƙwallon kwando ba' da tambayar ke nema, sannan ka kwatanta shawarwarin biyu.

z-m-35-01.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka yawan ɗaliban da ba su shiga ƙwallon ƙafa ko ƙwallon kwando ba shi ne 20.

z-m-35-01.s.s2.prompt: Jisu ya sami 20; yawan waɗanne ɗalibai ne wannan? Zaɓi mafi kyawun bayanin ɗaliban da ainihin lissafin 24 − 4 ke ƙirga.

z-m-35-01.s.s2.hint.1: Daga cikin ɗalibai 24 duka, ka rubuta rukuni-rukuni irin ɗaliban da suka rage cikin 20 bayan cire 4.

z-m-35-05.s.s1.explain: A [Jadawali 1], 가 ya aika wa 나, 다, 라 duka, saboda haka ㄴ gaskiya ce. Amma babu wanda ya aika wa 가, saboda haka ㄱ ƙarya ce.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.prompt: Harin ya ce ㄴ ma gaskiya ce a [Jadawali 2], sannan ya bayyana kamar haka. A wane layi ne dabarar ta fara yin kuskure? An ƙirga layukan daga 1.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.hint.0: A [Jadawali 2], bincika layi bayan layi ko layin 가 ya ƙunshi sauran ɗalibai ukun duka.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta da jimlar ㄴ batun cewa a ㄱ, 'mai aikawa' ga kowane ɗalibi na iya zama mutum ɗaya ko mabambanta.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.0: A [Jadawali 2], 가 ya aika wa 나, 나 ya aika wa 다, 다 ya aika wa 라, kuma 라 ya aika wa 가.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.1: Idan aka duba ɓangaren mai karɓa, kowane daga cikin 가, 나, 다, 라 ya karɓi saƙo sau ɗaya, saboda haka ㄱ gaskiya ce.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.2: Kasancewar kowane ɗalibi ya karɓi saƙo yana nufin akwai mai aikawa ga kowane ɗalibi, saboda haka ɗalibi guda ya aika wa duk sauran.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka ㄴ ma gaskiya ce a [Jadawali 2].
z-m-35-05.s.s2.explain: Har zuwa layi na 2 daidai ne (ㄱ gaskiya ce a [Jadawali 2]). Layi na 3 ne ya yi kuskure ta cewa daga 'ga kowane ɗalibi akwai mai aikawa' (mai aikawa na iya bambanta ga kowane mai karɓa), ana iya kammalawa cewa 'ɗalibi guda ya aika wa kowa' (mai aikawa ɗaya ne ga kowa). A [Jadawali 2], kowane ɗalibi ya aika wa mutum guda kawai, saboda haka ㄴ ƙarya ce. Kammalawar layi na 4 ba daidai ba ce saboda layi na 3.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.prompt: Bisa jadawalin biyun, yanke hukunci ko 'idan ㄴ gaskiya ce, dole ㄱ ma ta zama gaskiya' da kuma 'idan ㄱ gaskiya ce, dole ㄴ ma ta zama gaskiya' dukkansu suna tabbata koyaushe, sannan ka rubuta jadawalin da ya zama hujja ga kowane hukunci.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta ko ㄱ da ㄴ gaskiya ne ko ƙarya a [Jadawali 1], sannan ka yi haka ga [Jadawali 2].
z-m-35-05.s.s3.hint.1: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa idan akwai jadawali inda ɗaya gaskiya ɗaya kuma ƙarya, 'dole ne' a wannan alkiblar ya karye.

z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.0: Babu ɗaya da ke tabbata koyaushe. A Jadawali 1, ㄴ gaskiya ce amma ㄱ ƙarya ce domin babu wanda ya aika wa 가. A Jadawali 2, ㄱ gaskiya ce amma ㄴ ƙarya ce (kowane mai aikawa ya aika wa mutum guda kawai). Saboda haka akwai misalin da ke karyata kowace alkibla.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.1: Ko da ㄴ gaskiya ce, babu tabbacin cewa ㄱ ma gaskiya ce (Jadawali 1 misali ne da ya karyata hakan); kuma ko da ㄱ gaskiya ce, babu tabbacin ㄴ gaskiya ce (Jadawali 2 ya karyata hakan). Cewa kowane ɗalibi yana da mai aikawa da kuma cewa ɗalibi guda ya aika wa kowa ba abu ɗaya ba ne domin tsarin 'kowanne' da 'akwai' ya bambanta.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.2: A jadawali na 1, ㄴ gaskiya ce kuma ㄱ ƙarya ce; a jadawali na 2, ㄱ gaskiya ce kuma ㄴ ƙarya ce, saboda haka babu ɗaya da aka tabbatar koyaushe.

z-m-35-06.title: Ƙirƙiri sharudda biyu da kanka da adadin misalan da ke karyata su ya kayyade
z-m-35-06.topic: Ƙirga misalan da ke karyata magana 'idan p to q' da kishiyarta (haɗaɗɗen saitunan gaskiya)
z-m-35-06.goal: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa bambancin saitunan gaskiya shi ne saitin misalan da ke karyatawa, domin tsara sharudda biyu da suka cika ƙuntatawar adadin misalai. Sannan ka kwatanta mafita daban-daban.
z-m-35-06.material: Da saitin duniya U={1, 2, 3, …, 12}, yi la'akari da sharudda biyu p: x≥a, q: x≤b. a da b lambobi cikakku ne daga 1 zuwa 12, P da Q kuma su ne saitunan gaskiya na p da q bi da bi. Misalin da ke karyata magana 'idan p to q' shi ne ɓangaren U inda p gaskiya ce q kuma ƙarya ce; misalin da ke karyata kishiyarta 'idan q to p' shi ne ɓangaren da q gaskiya ce p kuma ƙarya. (Yadda ake karantawa: x≥a na nufin 'x ya kai a ko ya fi', x≤b kuma na nufin 'x ya kai b ko ya gaza'.)

z-m-35-06.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne ya fi bayyana misalan da ke karyata magana 'idan p to q' ta amfani da saitunan gaskiya P da Q?
z-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi abu ɗaya ko biyu daga U da kanka waɗanda suka dace da ma'anar misali mai karyatawa ('sharadin p gaskiya ne amma ƙarshe q ƙarya ne').

z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.a: Abin da yake cikin P amma ba ya cikin Q (P−Q)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka juya ma'anar misalin da ke karyatawa, 'p gaskiya ce amma q ƙarya ce', zuwa harshen saituna.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.b: Abin da yake cikin Q amma ba ya cikin P (Q−P)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.b: Waɗannan abubuwan ne suke karyata 'idan q to p'. Ka sake duba ma'anar misali mai karyatawa: inda 'sharadi gaskiya ne, ƙarshe kuma ƙarya'.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.c: Abin da yake cikin P da Q duka (P∩Q)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.c: Abin da p da q duka suke gaskiya a kansa ba ya karyata 'idan p to q', a maimakon haka yana goya mata baya. Kwatanta da ma'anar misali mai karyatawa.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.d: Abin da ba ya cikin P ko Q
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.d: Kwatanta da ma'anar misali mai karyatawa: wace rawa abu inda p da q duka ƙarya ne yake takawa ga 'idan p to q'?
z-m-35-06.s.s1.explain: Misali mai karyata 'idan p to q' shi ne abu inda p gaskiya ce q kuma ƙarya ce, wato abin da ke cikin P amma ba ya cikin Q, saboda haka P−Q (=P∩Qᶜ). Misali mai karyata kishiyar 'idan q to p' kuma Q−P ne.
